desc: Through the years, Pachmayr has listened to what their customers and MSR shooters have been looking for in an AR-15 Grip. They then took this input and designed the new AR-15 Grip. It has all of the features that have been asked for, including a hand-filling yet slim shape, shallow finger grooves for fast grip acquisition, and proper hand location for easy trigger reach and control. The grip has a synthetic rubber over-mold construction, along with a good looking yet non-slip texture. The grip is impervious to gun oils or solvents and will stand up to rough use.
